The test calls os.Getenv("CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL") directly (no t.Run dialect loop, so it skips under its own bare name), and the cluster job's env sets only CLEAT_TEST_DB/CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES (ci.yml, the cluster's own database block) -- no CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL at all, so this skips as "nothing configured", not a connection failure.
same test, same reason: multi-db/mysql sets only CLEAT_TEST_MYSQL and no CLEAT_TEST_MSSQL, so this skips here too -- see the cluster line above.
